t_splash.text: Before it plays: the system splash

n_splash.text: Both system splashes are one static picture for everyone: the plain icon on Low Sun’s ground (#14110E), the manifest’s background_color. Neither can move or read the saved theme. Android draws it from the manifest already. iPhone needs apple-touch-startup-image files (one per screen size); The 99 ships none today, so this one is owed. The app’s first paint is that same icon in the same spot, so the loader picks up with no jump.

n_where.text: Where it plays (all three options): the installed app’s cold start only (display-mode standalone), never in a browser tab or on later navigations. It never holds the app: Home loads underneath the whole time, and the hand-off starts as soon as the mark lands. Every option runs in Low Sun so it continues the splash, then blends into the saved theme as Home fades up (the theme row of each option shows it). Reduced motion: a straight cut from the splash to Home. The boards marked ▶ play the real animation (looping, with a 2-second rest on Home); the frames after them are that same animation paused.

t_d.text: D · The flip, then the crown lights (A + B)

t_f.text: D2 · The flip, then the crown lights, slowed to 1.6 s

n_a.text: Timeline: 0 to 110 ms the mark holds at icon size. 110 to 360 ms it grows (expo out). Then the crown lights one diamond at a time, left (330), right (400), centre (470): each eases to a pale gold with a 1.3× pulse and back. The centre lights last, holds, and blooms a soft glow behind it (the one glow on screen, gone by 720). THE NINETY-NINE rises under the mark at 400 to 580 (the signed-out hero’s label). 680 to 850 ms the mark shrinks into the header logo’s exact spot while Home fades up. In app: the loading screen’s crown keeps its stagger but lights instead of blinking (same 1.2 s loop). Closest sibling to Concert Crawl’s.

n_b.text: Timeline: 0 to 110 ms the mark holds at icon size. 110 to 360 ms it grows and a card back fills in under it (The 99’s own back: a diamond lattice in the accent, not Wizards’ back), with a −5° tilt. 390 to 650 ms the card flips face up and straightens. 600 to 860 ms a foil glint crosses the face (the shipped foil colours). 690 to 860 ms the mark lifts off the card into the header while the card fades. In app: the loading screen’s crown sits on a small card that flips every 1.6 s with a slight rock. The most personality; also the busiest in one second.

n_c.text: Timeline: 0 to 110 ms the mark holds at icon size. 110 to 360 ms it grows and the crown lifts off. 300 to 620 ms the numeral counts up to 99 (like the app’s CountUp). A diamond drops back at 33, another at 66, and the large one at 99, each with a small overshoot, then a soft glow. 680 to 850 ms the mark shrinks into the header while Home fades up. In app: the loading screen’s crown builds one diamond at a time and lifts away (1.4 s loop). The one that says “99”.

n_d.text: A + B, with a little magic. 0 to 110 ms the mark holds at icon size. 110 to 330 ms it grows and the card back fills in under it, tilted −6°. 350 to 570 ms the card flips face up and straightens. Then the crown lights on the card’s face: left (590), right (650), centre (710). As the centre lights, the card’s edge glows, a soft bloom opens behind the crown and eight small four-point sparkles burst out and fade (pale gold plus the shipped foil colours), while the foil glint crosses the face. 760 to 920 ms the mark lifts off the card into the header as the card fades, and Home is fully in by 1.04 s. In app: the small card flips face up, its crown lights left, right, centre, and it turns back (2 s loop). Reduced motion: a cut, same as the others.

n_e.text: A2 = A exactly, plus D’s sparkles: as the centre diamond lights (475 ms), eight small four-point sparkles (pale gold plus the shipped foil colours) burst out from the crown and fade by about 700 ms, before the mark flies. Nothing else changes, so it still lands at 0.85 s and Home is in by 0.95 s. In app: same as A (the sparkles stay a launch-only moment).

n_f.text: D2 = D with every beat stretched 1.6×, so the whole thing takes about 1.66 s instead of 1.04. Grow 180 to 530 ms, flip 560 to 910, the crown lights at 945, 1040, 1135, sparkles and the card glow at about 1.15 to 1.5 s, the mark lifts to the header 1.22 to 1.47 s, Home fully in at 1.66 s. Trade-off: Home is never held, but this is the length a person watches every time they open the app. In app: same as D.
